title: A tasting-room brief at a small roastery
titleZh: 小型烘豆坊試飲室的簡報
passage:
Before we open the tasting room, two things. In yesterday’s test, a shorter brew kept the smell but left less taste at the end; adding water reduced both. Use plain cups today. A sample in a cup that smells of soap tells us more about the cup than the coffee.

The café wants to try the same coffee on its own machine. Their grinder takes whole beans. Thursday’s roast arrived after the manager left; before her visit we had roasted only on Wednesday. The tasting packets on the North tray are already ground. We have two unopened bags of whole beans: Thursday’s is by the scale and Wednesday’s is in the cupboard.

When the manager next comes in, remember what she said after tasting. “That’s a little heavy,” she said. She pointed to her mouth after swallowing, then lifted the cup. “But don’t lose that part. I notice it before I even take a sip.”
passageZh:
試飲室開門前先提醒兩件事。昨天的測試裡，縮短沖煮時間能保留香氣，尾韻也比較淡；加水則兩者都會變淡。今天請用沒有異味的杯子。用有肥皂味的杯子裝樣品，喝到的可能是杯子的味道，不是咖啡。

咖啡店想用自己的機器試同一款咖啡。他們的磨豆機需要整顆豆子。經理離開後，星期四烘的豆子才到；她到訪前，我們只在星期三烘過一次。北側托盤上的試飲小包已經磨成粉。我們有兩袋未開封的整豆：星期四烘的在秤旁，星期三烘的在櫃子裡。

經理下次再來時，記得她試喝後的話。她說：「有一點厚重。」她吞下去後指著自己的嘴，再拿起杯子說：「不過這部分要留下，我連第一口都還沒喝就注意到了。」

The tasting packets on the North tray are already ground. We have two unopened bags of whole beans: Thursday’s is by the scale and Wednesday’s is in the cupboard.

When the manager next comes in, remember what she said after tasting. “That’s a little heavy,” she said. She pointed to her mouth after swallowing, then lifted the cup. “But don’t lose that part. I notice it before I even take a sip.”
